summary: ADJ86 pilot v2 — the REAL framework as a PIPELINE, 2x2 (Haiku,Opus) x (bare,framework). Phase 1: scenario -> input-IR (typed slots, verbatim spans, null for unstated). Phase 2: the rulebook derivation takes the INPUT-IR + policy and derives rules OVER THE IR'S EXISTING SLOTS (so the two stages cannot represent the same thing differently). Then deterministic engine.py adjudicates. Plus a bare one-shot arm. A FIXED blind auditor scores bare-prose defensibility. Thesis: framework-Haiku reaches plain-Opus defensibility.
